meta.title: Skill switchboard
meta.description: Manage the skills you own: enable or disable, full-text search, spec check with one-click fix, SKILL.md editor, create, import a folder or .zip, move between user/agents/project roots, tag, and delete into a restorable trash. Only your own skills are listed (bundled and plugin-provided skills stay out). The switch writes SKILL.md frontmatter and the filesystem watcher reloads it — no restart.
panel.title: Skills
panel.modelToggle.desc: Let the model invoke this skill on its own
panel.userToggle.desc: Allow invoking via /skill-name in the composer
panel.enabledToggle.desc: Enable = available to both model and user; disable = hidden from both
panel.disabledNote: Only skills you installed or wrote yourself are shown (bundled and plugin skills excluded). Toggles write back to SKILL.md frontmatter (auto re-discovery, no restart); disabled skills are marked Off.
panel.noPath: No file path for this skill (bundled or unusual source); cannot toggle.
